description: Evacuate 14,000 residents from low-lying Sagar Island wards to Sagar Central Shelter and Namkhana Shelter
Close NH-12 coastal causeway to light emergency and civilian vehicles ahead of 0.48m predicted inundation
Proactively de-energise 33kV Sagar Island Substation prior to saltwater inundation to prevent transformer failure
Pre-position 2 portable diesel generators and mobile telecom satellite kit at Kakdwip Sub-Divisional Hospital
